task.description: storypole list hides archived tickets and says nothing about it. A store whose tickets are all archived prints "No tasks found matching filter criteria" - identical to a store with no tickets, an unreadable store, or one whose index failed to build. Measured 2026-11-10 during GB-347: dado holds 3 tickets, all archived, and lists as empty; --include-archived shows all 3; batten behaves the same way with its 1 ticket; rabbet lists because it has unarchived rows. The filter is documented in --help but the output gives the operator no way to tell "hidden by filter" from "store is empty", which is why it was read as a store-health defect during the remint and written into GB-347 as one. Fix is small: print the hidden count when rows were filtered out. Filed at the harness because CO-1 is still owned by common until the GB-347 remint lands; this is storypole-CLI work and should be reminted into storypole with the rest.
